title: S22+ bluetooth constant paring request
body:
I just upgraded to an S22+. Installed the newest nightly build as I had on my old device. I transferred all settings via QR code. Unfortunately I'm getting intermittent bluetooth paring request for the transmitter. I've tried resetting the BT and all basic functions. Is this a phone or xdrip issue? 
![Screenshot_20220408-154204_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25514585/162543356-ce786875-8474-467e-b38b-221fef0ed8a1.jpg)
![Screenshot_20220408-154212_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25514585/162543358-e5ee2e59-1ffb-4d4c-b9c1-49ad85618ac1.jpg)
